_note: What VidChain's fallbacks must do on every fixture and fault (T6.2), with fallbacks ON. 'untouched' = the current method succeeded in the golden, no chain may start and its files stay byte-identical; 'delivered' = a chain must end with a committed file; 'exhausted' = nothing can rescue it (no cookie / referer anywhere, or the fault persists), the chain must end cleanly without delivering anything; 'either' = delivered or exhausted are both acceptable (reason given). Every case: no more crash logs than the unchanged app had (golden / fault matrix), no chain still running after the driver's wait.

reasons.drive-interstitial: an invented host: L only knows the real Google Drive; a page scraper may still follow the confirm link
reasons.cookie-gated: the share carries no cookie and no browser session exists for the host
reasons.referer-gated: the share carries no referer and the page that would supply it was never opened
